top_signals.title: FAA halts flights to Newark, Philadelphia, New York because of equipment problem
top_signals.summary: An FAA equipment problem snarled air travel at Newark Liberty International Airport and Philadelphia International Airport Monday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stock boom is fueling a ‘retirement party,’ economists say — what it means for workers
top_signals.summary: Stocks have surged and the resulting "wealth effect" has led older workers to retire at a faster clip.
